name: Trove
description:
Trove turns your work into a career story worth telling.

Most of what you accomplish disappears the moment you move on to the next thing. Trove captures it as artifacts — specific, verifiable moments of work — and assembles them into a narrative you actually own.

With this connector, Claude can:

• Capture work as it happens. Just shipped a feature, closed a deal, or finished an analysis in Claude? Turn it into a draft artifact without leaving the conversation.
• Pull up your existing artifacts so Claude can reference your real track record when writing your resume, prepping for an interview, or drafting a performance review.
• Read your Trove profile for context on your role, skills, and career arc.

Artifacts can be sent to colleagues for verification, so your story is backed by the people who were there.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trove to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://thetrove.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trove MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trove provides these MCP tools: create_draft_artifact, get_my_profile, and list_my_artifacts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trove?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Trove in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Trove requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Trove is developed by Trove. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
